create_COCODataset: create a COCODataset instance for GLigen training with image path, data path, and tokenizer
recalculate_box_and_verify_if_valid: recalculate bounding box coordinates after image resize and verify minimum box size threshold

summarize_COCODataset_len: summarize COCODataset __len__ to return the total number of items in the dataset
